workers_ai.note: Always available — Cloudflare Workers AI (GPT-OSS 120B production reasoning model)

openai.note: Set via wrangler secret put OPENAI_API_KEY, or POST /api/v1/agent/providers

anthropic.note: Set via wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or POST /api/v1/agent/providers

gemini.note: Set via wrangler secret put GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY, or POST /api/v1/agent/providers

openrouter.note: OpenRouter routes to any model (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, etc.)

agents.note: ZeroClaw fetches dynamic provider config from the BoA backend on each cron run. Informational generation is pinned to Workers AI GPT-OSS 120B; provider records remain available only for explicit specialist integrations.

api.note: ZeroClaw authenticates to the BoA backend using the ADMIN_API_KEY environment variable

jobs.name: article-generator
jobs.message: Poll the BoA backend for agent_tasks with type='generate_article' and status='pending'. For each pending task, generate a Guardian-style article using the article-generator skill, then POST the result back to the BoA API to publish it.

jobs.name: proactive-editorial
jobs.message: Scan the BoA content database for articles with status='pending_audit' or articles that have not been audited in more than 7 days. Audit each one and submit results.

jobs.name: self-improving-editorial
jobs.message: Run the nightly instruction evolution cycle: reflect on recent audits and human feedback, synthesize new editorial rules, and append them to the learned.md knowledge base.
